title: Progressive Experience Fusion for Multi-Task World Model Control in Endovascular Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2608.18647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous endovascular navigation could support the delivery of mechanical thrombectomy to underserved areas, but controllers must navigate long, multi-stage paths across varying vascular anatomies. This study investigates Progressive Experience Fusion (PEF) to train a multi-task TD-MPC2 controller. We additionally evaluate a heuristic that changes the Model Predictive Path Integral planning horizon using residual action-sequence dispersion, and fine-tuning in a patient-specific simulation. Across five subtasks in ten known training anatomies with held-out targets, PEF achieved a mean success rate of 74%, compared with 37% for Soft Actor-Critic (p < 0.001) and 65% for base TD-MPC2 (p = 0.053). A PEF controller with adaptive-horizon planning trained on 30 vasculatures achieved a mean success rate of 90% in ten held-out vasculatures. The PEF agent successfully transferred to an unseen in vitro stroke patient vasculature under fluoroscop

translated_title: 渐进式经验融合用于血管内导航中的多任务世界模型控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18647v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：自主血管内导航可以支持在偏远地区进行机械取栓治疗，但控制器必须穿越不同血管解剖结构中的长距离、多阶段路径。本研究探讨了渐进式经验融合（PEF）来训练多任务TD-MPC2控制器。我们还评估了一种启发式方法，该方法使用残差动作序列离散度来改变模型预测路径积分规划范围，并在患者特定模拟中进行微调。在十个已知训练解剖结构中的五个子任务（使用保留目标）中，PEF实现了平均成功率为74%，而软演员-评论家（SAC）为37%（p < 0.001），基础TD-MPC2为65%（p = 0.053）。使用自适应范围规划在30个血管结构上训练的PEF控制器在十个保留血管结构中实现了平均90%的成功率。PEF代理成功迁移到荧光透视下未见过的体外中风患者血管结构。
tldr: 本文提出渐进式经验融合方法，结合自适应规划范围启发式，显著提升了多任务TD-MPC2在血管内导航中的成功率（达90%），并成功迁移至未见过的患者血管结构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Progressive Experience Fusion with adaptive planning horizon heuristics, significantly improving multi-task TD-MPC2 success rates (up to 90%) in endovascular navigation and enabling transfer to unseen patient vasculature.
